type Json = string | number | JsonArray | JsonObject;
interface JsonArray extends Array<Json> {}
interface JsonObject { [k: string]: Json }
const j: Json = { a: "x", b: [1] };
interface Tree extends Array<Tree> {}
const t: Tree = [[], [[]]];
const s: string[] = ["a"];
const j2: JsonArray = s;
const j3: JsonArray = ["a"];
interface Plain extends Array<number> {}
const p: Plain = [1, 2];
console.log(j, t, j2, j3, p);
